cwd.description: Absolute path to the launch working directory. Must already exist and be a real named folder, not a bare '_' leaf.

prompt.description: The task text passed to the agent.

model.description: Harness-specific model id/alias. Independently settable on resume.

background.description: Whether to launch detached (non-blocking) or wait for completion.

resumeOf.description: Session ID to resume from. null means a fresh dispatch. Never leave this implicit.

label.description: Optional human-readable name for this dispatch, for ledger readability.
